canonical_project: Google LaGrange / Project Pegasus Data Center

acreage_reported.note: Reported by DCD/Baxtel for the Thor-acquired parcel and inherited Google campus site.
Reported by AJC/Cleanview for the broader Project Pegasus site.

capacity_evidence.official_scope: DCA DRI #4797 / PRL2 application, submitted by LaGrange for KDC as agent at 411 Pegasus Parkway.
capacity_evidence.tracker_or_media_note: Cleanview lists 400 MW; DCD says Thor previously targeted eventual 400 MW and 50 MW for the first building. Treat as eventual-campus context, not an official confirmed energized capacity.

why_not_in_baseline: Not present in the 208 baseline canonical_project list; likely missed Georgia hyperscaler project and distinct from baseline Georgia entries in Coweta, Muscogee, Spalding, and Twiggs counties.

contradictions.summary: Official DCA PRL2 filing states 350 MW estimated peak connected electrical load for the proposed project. Cleanview lists 400 MW and DCD/Baxtel report Thor's earlier eventual-campus target of 400 MW, while DCD also reports a prior 50 MW first-building target. Use 350 MW as the current official load figure and retain 400 MW only as eventual-campus context.

DCD/Baxtel report a 270-acre parcel; AJC/Cleanview report a 420-acre Project Pegasus site. Both are retained because public records reviewed here do not reconcile parcel versus broader campus acreage.
